ModMetaData.name: Convergence: Grafts
ModMetaData.author: Prospero1088
ModMetaData.description:
Dao grafts for Convergence: Era of Cultivation.
Bionic-style implants made of spirit beast parts and jade, with myth-themed names and lore: trade grafts (divine farmer, Dao miner, celestial smith, alchemist, healer, mountain builder, jade artist, beast shepherd), beast grafts (Dao bones, dragon veins, thousand-li eyes, steed legs) and beast organs (dragon lungs, jade kidneys, wind-hearing ears, qilin skin). They are forged in a bone refining furnace and installed on a Dao grafting altar; implants can be removed again with ordinary surgery. For the early game, simple spirit-wood limbs and a jade denture can be carved at a crafting spot and fitted by any healer without an altar. Each graft carries a small celestial dissonance. No industrial research and no electricity.
Requires Convergence: Era of Cultivation.
